notes.title: Improvement for New Earth
notes.notes:
Hi!

[b]New Earth[/b] was developed in 2020-2023, and it was finished in the Spring of 2023. Time passed, and I can provide better graphics right now compared to 2020-2023.

Therefore, I want to improve it by adding more images to make the animations look nicer.

And the game will be automatically updated for everyone who has already been owning it.

Thank you for supporting me!

Best Regards,

[b]MiZtyl[/b]

notes.title: MAC & Linux fixed
notes.notes:
Hi,
I was new to Steam so I made a mistake: MAC and Linux were used the executed files of Windows. I fixed it after our friend linuxminded pointed out what was wrong.
Please try the game again if you're MAC or Linux users (by giving the demo a try first to make sure everything is fine now).
Thank you, and I'm sorry for this.
Best Regards!
